text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing steady VRAM growth on staging during long-context Llama-70B runs on MI250x. Looks like KV page-table/slot alignment slowly drifts and we accumulate ~200MB/hour. attaching short traces.
kevin: Are you sure it's not just prefix cache retention? any repro?
maria: repro is reproducible with continuous generation + periodic checkpointing. small command I used:
```
REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 ./run_infer --model llm-70b --ctx 25600 --batch 1 --gpu mi250x --profile kvcache
```
perf-bot: [alert] kvcache.page_walks=1.19M, page_evictions=23.4k, unexpected_page_hits=0.8% (15:03 UTC) :warning:
liam: can you paste the kvcache summary from the trace?
maria: sure, pasted snippets below — note the repeated page-table remap ops and a bunch of small frees that don't seem to decrease resident size: 
```
kvcache.total_entries: 2.3M
kvcache.resident_bytes: 18.6GB -> 19.1GB (over 45m)
kvcache.page_walks: 1,197,432
kvcache.page_remap_retries: 4,312
kvcache.eviction_coalesces: 0
page_table.shadow_stamps: [0x12, 0x12, 0x13, 0x13, 0x13, 0x14]
```
kevin: interesting — shadow_stamps increasing suggests we might be allocating new page-table slabs instead of reusing. did the kernel selector pick different tiled kernels on ROCm vs CUDA?
maria: yes. on MI250x runtime log shows `kernel_select: tiled_kernel_v4_rocm` while on H100 it picks `tiled_kernel_v2_cuda`. I tried forcing the cuda-like tiling on rocm via env and got slightly different behavior.
adele: my hunch: JIT/tiling variant on ROCm does a different per-page ownership write ordering which races with our pt-evict compact path, resulting in shadow slabs being orphaned. not classic leak but reuse failure.
liam: could be the atomic coalesce heuristic — on CUDA the kernel does an atomic add to a slab index before commit, on ROCm it uses a lockless CAS loop that might fail to publish the slot early.
kevin: do we have a small repro that toggles kernel variants? if so we can add an integration test that asserts resident_bytes stabilizes after N tokens.
maria: yes, quick script: 
```
for K in tiled_kernel_v2_cuda tiled_kernel_v4_rocm tiled_kernel_v4_rocm_force_atomic; do
  REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=$K REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 ./run_infer --model llm-70b --ctx 16000 --batch 1 --run-time 20m --profile kvcache >> trace.$K.log
done
```
perf-bot: [info] CI note: there is an existing flaky test kvcache/longctx-growth that times out on MI250x (flaky rate 6%).
kevin: ok I'll wire that loop into a reproducible unit that asserts <50MB growth. I'll also add a telemetry metric for `page_table.orphan_slabs` so we can quantify. assigning to me.
maria: another data point — when I triggered a manual GC path (force-evict) resident_bytes drops but not as much as expected, and the page remap retry counter spikes. looks like remap path is skipping some indices.
liam: can you paste a short kernel trace around remap? the chronological ordering might show the publish vs reclaim interleaving.
maria: pasted a minimal trace excerpt: 
```
[14:12:32.123] threaded-kv: publish_index(0x7f8b) -> success
[14:12:32.124] remap-slab: pte_write idx=0x7f8b -> queued
[14:12:32.124] evict-path: mark_free idx=0x7f8b -> free queue push
[14:12:32.125] remap-slab: pte_commit idx=0x7f8b -> ENOENT (race?)
[14:12:32.126] orphan-slab: create new slab id=0x8a1c
```
adele: that ENOENT on pte_commit is the smoking gun. race where commit expects slot to exist but evict path already removed metadata. on CUDA timing the commit wins. on ROCm commit loses.
kevin: likely fix: make commit idempotent and ensure remap acquires slab refcount before evict dequeues it. also add a fast-path CAS-based ref increment in tiled kernel.
maria: I can prototype the idempotent commit behavior and run the three-kernel loop tomorrow on both H100 and MI.
liam: I'll audit the eviction code for ordering guarantees. if we need a quick mitigation we can make the remap retry loop escalate to global lock after N attempts.
kevin: good plan. I'll open an issue with reproducer + perf traces and tag @eng-runtime @eng-ml. PR to include: unit + telemetry + idempotent commit.
ops-bot: created issue RW-kkv-2042: "kv-page-table-commit-race-orphan-slabs (MI250x)" with priority P1.
maria: thanks — leaving traces in /s3/perf/traces/6151234567/ and I'll attach nvprof/rocprof outputs.
adele: one more ask — can we record kernel binary signatures in trace to see if different compiler flags cause behavior delta? add `KERNEL_SIG` to trace metadata.
kevin: will do. assigning follow-ups: kevin (issue + unit + telemetry), maria (traces H100+MI + quick prototype idempotent commit), liam (evict ordering audit). aim to have an initial PR by end of week. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone, starting runs now.
